name: fx-coding-agent
title: Fx Coding Agent
description: Run fx coding agent commands, inspect sessions, and delegate work from Raycast AI
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Sessions
commands.subtitle: fx
commands.description: Search, inspect, and resume local fx sessions

commands.name: ask-fx
commands.title: Ask Fx
commands.subtitle: fx
commands.description: Run a noninteractive request in a selected workspace

commands.name: start-session
commands.title: Open Fx Session
commands.subtitle: fx
commands.description: Start, resume, or choose an interactive fx session

commands.name: check-fx
commands.title: Check Fx Health
commands.subtitle: fx
commands.description: View fx status and local health checks

commands.name: view-usage
commands.title: View Fx Usage
commands.subtitle: fx
commands.description: View locally recorded fx token usage and spend

tools.name: list-fx-sessions
tools.title: List Fx Sessions
tools.description: Lists saved fx coding agent sessions across one or all workspaces

tools.name: inspect-fx-session
tools.title: Inspect Fx Session
tools.description: Reads the metadata and conversation history of an exact fx session

tools.name: ask-fx
tools.title: Ask Fx
tools.description: Delegates a confirmed coding request to fx within a specific workspace

preferences.name: fxPath
preferences.title: Fx Executable
preferences.description: Command name or full path to the fx executable

preferences.name: defaultWorkspace
preferences.title: Default Workspace
preferences.description: Optional workspace used by health, usage, and AI tools when a workspace is not supplied

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
